## Purpose

Describe the problem and what this change improves. Link the agreed proposal or issue where applicable.

## Changes

Summarize the affected content, assets, or templates. Include screenshots for visible changes where useful.

## Validation

Describe what you checked and the result. Mention any checks you could not complete.

## Review

- [ ] The change follows the agreed scope, or is a small factual or typographical correction.
- [ ] Public-facing text is in English and factual claims have been checked.
- [ ] Changed links and relevant rendered content have been reviewed.
- [ ] No credentials, client data, mailbox contents, or confidential assets are included.
- [ ] I have identified any changes that require owner approval under GOVERNANCE.md.
